Variance factor of an equally weighted quantile average

Source: R/utils.R
inf_cq_local.Rd

For quantile levels \(\tau_j = j / (K + 1)\), \(j = 1, \dots, K\), computes \(K^{-2} \sum_{j,k} (\min(\tau_j, \tau_k) - \tau_j \tau_k) / (f_j f_k)\), the asymptotic variance factor of the equally weighted average of K quantile estimators.

Usage

inf_cq_local(f)

Arguments

f

Numeric vector of length K, the (conditional) densities evaluated at the K quantiles.

Value

Numeric scalar.
